headline: Argentina Adds $700M Collateral to $6 Billion Bank Repo Facility
summary: Argentina's central bank added $700 million in cash and bonds to its $6 billion bank repurchase agreement after a 26% drop in collateral bond values triggered margin replenishment requirements.
why: Argentina's central bank repo liquidity facilities are crucial to guaranteeing upcoming sovereign debt amortizations and maintaining reserve stability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: The central bank had to inject $700M in additional collateral to maintain its $6B bank repo facility.
